missionSettings.description: FAULT LINE 4/5 - MEUSE CROSSING. The North strikes back in the east. From Leuven, Tienen and Landen, three armoured columns push south past Beauvechain on the southern line in front of Namur, at Gembloux, Eghezee and Andenne. The bridges over the Meuse at Namur are the prize. Rocket artillery near Boutersem covers them; the South has a reserve in Namur. NORTH: break 70% of the southern line. SOUTH: destroy 75% of the three columns. Both sides playable: PvP, or co-op against the AI. Requires NOCustomMaps and the Belgica map (Nuclear Option Mod Manager). Fictional scenario: North = Boscali, South = Primeva. No nuclear weapons.

objectives.DisplayName: Break the southern line in front of Namur

outcomes.Message: First column out of Leuven, driving south past Beauvechain on Gembloux.
Second column out of Tienen, through Jodoigne towards Eghezee.
Third column out of Landen, through Hannut, going for Andenne and the Meuse.
The southern line has broken. Northern armour is on the Meuse at Namur.
The northern offensive has stalled in the Hesbaye. Namur holds.
The Namur reserve is moving up to Eghezee. Cover it.
North, the counter-offensive begins. Cover the columns and get us to the Meuse.
South, northern armour is moving out of Brabant. Hold the line in front of Namur.
Hit them at the crossings, and find the rocket artillery near Boutersem.
